name: govee-lights
description: Control selected Govee lights locally and send temporary task-completion, attention, error, and information signals.

interface.shortDescription: Local light controls and AI task signals
interface.longDescription: Connect to the Govee Lights Windows app. Control permitted lights and presets, or send a brief signal that restores lighting and resumes screen sync afterward. Requires a local Windows desktop chat.
defaultPrompt: Use Govee Lights to signal when this task finishes or needs my attention.
Use Govee Lights to show my available lights and lighting presets.
